acceptance_rule: focused tests and lean-strict audit pass while exp-20260901-001 ticket/log/artifact identities remain unchanged

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Lean reflection audit should accept substantive post-run reflection from an exact SHA-256-bound private-replay artifact when its canonical log intentionally stores only the compact result summary.

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). Coordinate via scripts/list_experiments.py and scripts/agent_mailbox.py instead of racing.

nearest.reopen_condition: Reopen only for one reproducible artifact path, digest, identity, disposition, or evidence-invalid bypass or contract-v2 disposition change; one post-ticket missing-shard, alternate-root, or mutation-order regression; or one post-enforcement hard-integrity miss or pre-enforcement legacy-orphan false block.

Future activation work should wait for more current-state closed replacement rows and should treat status=missing_comparator_bars or non_session_entry_fill rows as coverage blockers, not enriched comparator evidence.
No retry is needed unless another manifest hash mismatch or cross-ID wrapper write is detected.
Only a pre-entry daily snapshot with fetch_at/hash/last_complete_day and at least +50% and 10 new settled forward rows, or a genuinely new data source/gate shape, can reopen this surface.

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

recipe_lane_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 排名/枚举清单消费: consuming a ranked list or finite taxonomy with one fixed evaluation recipe, one item per ID, is loop unrolling — not new evidence. After the lane triggers, only a single pooled batch (once) or park is legal. Curated lanes: docs/recipe_lanes.jsonl.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one concrete surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The lean audit previously ignored substantive reflection stored in the exact hash-bound private-replay artifact because its canonical log intentionally contained only a compact result summary.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not accept unbound paths, mismatched artifact digests, non-private-replay tickets, or artifacts without deterministic boolean acceptance checks.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only for a reproducible reflection-integrity false negative or a path, digest, terminal identity, scope, or authority validation bypass.

result.notes: Exact artifact validation plus deterministic structured-check attribution removes the false weak-reflection failure without mutating the terminal experiment.
